content: jane-t/TaskNotesTimer v2.0.1 (2026-09-24, Tauri): always-on-top 227x200 overlay; polls GET /api/time/active every 3s (configurable); task <select> populated from /api/tasks/query filtered to status=in-progress, not archived, not completed, sorted by due, refreshed every 30s; START stops ALL active sessions then starts selected (single-timer semantics); STOP; HH:MM:SS count-up of current session only; pulsing dot when running; disconnect banner after 3 failed polls; settings: port, token, position, opacity, poll interval. No pause, no total-vs-estimate, no recent tasks, no today log, no entry descriptions.
